items.title: Research your destination thoroughly
items.detail: Check government advisories, local news and crime statistics, and ask in online forums.

items.title: Share your plans
items.detail: Create a detailed itinerary, share it with trusted contacts, set check-in times and agree code words.

items.title: Get comprehensive travel insurance
items.detail: Make sure it has robust medical cover, emergency evacuation and cover for your activities.

items.title: Copy your documents the smart way
items.detail: Photograph passport, visa and cards, store them securely in the cloud, and keep paper copies separately.

items.title: Learn key local emergency phrases
items.detail: Practice "Help," "Police," "Hospital," "Lost" and "I don't speak [language]" phonetically.

items.title: Choose a safe neighborhood and accommodation
items.detail: Read solo traveler reviews, prefer a 24-hour front desk and avoid ground floor rooms.

items.title: Book your first night and airport transfer
items.detail: Arrange both well in advance.

items.title: Verify your passport expiration date
items.detail: Many destinations ask for six or more months' validity beyond your trip.

items.title: Register with your embassy or consulate
items.detail: Use your government's free traveler registration service, if it has one.

items.title: Set up a money belt or hidden pouch
items.detail: Use it for your main funds and passport.

items.title: Pack a personal first aid kit
items.detail: Include prescriptions, pain relief, anti-diarrheal medicine and basic wound care.

items.title: Download offline maps and translation apps
items.detail: Save them to your phone and test them in airplane mode.

items.title: Bring portable phone chargers
items.detail: Pack power banks and adapters.

items.title: Pack a whistle or personal safety alarm
items.detail: Keep it where you can reach it.

items.title: Leave expensive jewelry at home
items.detail: Keep flashy valuables securely at home.

items.title: Notify your bank and card companies
items.detail: Give them your travel dates and destinations.

items.title: Check the weather forecast
items.detail: Pack suitable clothing that helps you blend in.

items.title: Pack light and smart
items.detail: Stay agile and discreet.

items.title: Do a morning safety check
items.detail: Review your plan for the day.

items.title: Stay in well-lit, busy areas
items.detail: Avoid isolated or dark places.

items.title: Walk with confident body language
items.detail: Avoid looking lost or distracted.

items.title: Keep your phone accessible but secure
items.detail: Avoid careless display and never leave it unattended.

items.title: Trust your gut feelings
items.detail: Leave uncomfortable or suspicious situations immediately.

items.title: Avoid headphones in unfamiliar or crowded places
items.detail: Keep your hearing available.

items.title: Research public transport routes
items.detail: Sit near drivers or conductors.

items.title: Keep bags closed and in front of you in crowds
items.detail: Especially on crowded transport.

items.title: Have tickets or exact change ready
items.detail: Prepare before boarding.

items.title: Pay attention to your stops
items.detail: Avoid getting lost in unfamiliar areas.

items.title: Use ATMs inside banks or hotel lobbies
items.detail: Never count money in public.

items.title: Carry small bills and divide your money
items.detail: Keep money and cards in several secure places.

items.title: Use a crossbody bag with sturdy zippers
items.detail: Never put valuables in back pockets.

items.title: Use travel locks and photograph your belongings
items.detail: Keep the photos for documentation.

items.title: Use a VPN on public Wi-Fi
items.detail: Where it is legal at your destination.

items.title: Limit alcohol and guard your drink
items.detail: Never accept drinks from strangers or leave yours unattended.

items.title: Choose busy, reputable places to eat
items.detail: Be careful with street food, and drink bottled water where quality is uncertain.

items.title: Meet new people only in public places
items.detail: Always tell someone your plans.

items.title: Don't share exact locations online
items.detail: Avoid saying that you are traveling alone.

items.title: Turn off location for social apps
items.detail: Use private messaging for sensitive communication.

items.title: Check in with trusted contacts
items.detail: Keep to the times you agreed.

items.title: Do an evening safety assessment
items.detail: Before going out or settling in for the night.

items.title: Save local emergency numbers
items.detail: Police, ambulance and fire: accessible and memorized.

items.title: Know your nearest embassy or consulate
items.detail: Save its contact details and address.

items.title: Hide emergency cash in several places
items.detail: Keep it discreet and separate.

items.title: Set up backup communication
items.detail: For example a second SIM or a Wi-Fi calling app.

items.title: Locate the nearest hospital and police station
items.detail: Learn where they are when you arrive.

items.title: Practice staying calm
items.detail: Know how to ask local authorities for help.

items.title: Be ready to make noise and leave
items.detail: Yell, use your alarm or physically remove yourself from danger.

items.title: Know who you will call
items.detail: Call someone you trust straight away to tell them your situation.
